npcs.name: Elara
quirks: always counting coins in her head
npcs.backstory: Runs the stall near the square; once travelled widely across distant lands, trading exotic goods. Now settled but still dreams of the open road.

relationships.notes: He buys healing supplies for the guard barracks
Provides fresh produce, but haggles too much
Repairs her tools and cart wheels

npcs.name: Maris
npcs.backstory: Learned herbal lore from her grandmother in the hills. Tends to the sick and wounded, asking only what people can afford to pay.

relationships.notes: Treats his injuries from patrol duty
Buys rare herbs from her sometimes
Childhood friends; he brings her fresh ingredients

npcs.name: Theron
quirks: early riser, greets everyone with dawn observations
npcs.backstory: Works the fields outside the village; comes to town for supplies. Lost his wife years ago but keeps farming the land they worked together.

relationships.notes: Sells produce to her, argues over prices

npcs.name: Garrick
npcs.backstory: A retired soldier who patrols the village walls. Saw action in the border wars and now keeps watch over the peaceful town, haunted by old memories.

relationships.notes: Admires his craftsmanship; Cedric maintains his armor
She patches him up after patrol incidents
Buys supplies from her merchant stall

npcs.name: Cedric
quirks: speaks loudly from years near the forge
npcs.backstory: Said to have forged swords for the city guard. Now runs the village smithy, taking pride in every piece of metalwork, from nails to blades.

relationships.notes: Repairs her cart and metal goods
